title: Fingerprints in JSON, SARIF, HTML and the printed issues (no baseline)
description: Without a baseline, the only change in 0.15.0 is that every issue carries partialFingerprints with the key ballerinaScanHash/v1, and no result carries baselineState. Two calls on one line get :1 and :2; the same line in taskOne and taskTwo also share a hash (:1, :2), since the enclosing function is not hashed. tests/main_test.bal gets its own path in the hash. Fingerprints are computed before rule selection and --exclude-tests, so leaving issues out never changes the fingerprints of the others: compare the Findings tables between steps.
upstream: BEP 1498: Finding fingerprints and baseline adoption (ballerina-spec/beps/tool-scan/1498_scan_baseline.md)
